payload.theorem_title: Exact rational logarithm enclosures for encoding and baseline entropy
payload.preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ThreeSumSharpTail_Analysis
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped BigOperators
payload.natural_language_statement: Encloses the natural logarithms of 2, 10, 3, 9, 1/21 and 20/21 between the exact rational endpoints in the statement. These enclosures certify the denominator log(4), the encoding cost and H(1/21) in the sharp-tail parameter certificate. They are obtained by rational atanh partial sums with explicit remainder bounds and power-of-two argument scaling.
payload.source: Yuxuan Xu, Deterministic Integer 3SUM in O(n^1.999017) Time via a Sharper Binomial-Tail Analysis (13 October 2026), Section 6.2; rational log-series certificate. Derived exact interval enclosures for the existing parameter certificate.

payload.theorem_title: Exact rational logarithm enclosures for the sharp-tail entropy arguments
payload.preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ThreeSumSharpTail_Analysis
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped BigOperators
payload.natural_language_statement: Encloses the natural logarithms of 44399/1050000, 1005601/1050000, 5601/50000 and 44399/50000 between the exact rational endpoints in the statement. The first pair describes u=(1-0.11202)/21 and 1-u; the second describes theta=0.11202 and 1-theta. The bounds certify the sharp saving and query exponent. The proof reuses the log(2) bounds from the encoding logarithm certificate to scale all arguments into [1,2].
